title: EvoMO-SR: Multiobjective LLM-based Evolution of Symbolic Expressions with substructure guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.36187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Symbolic Regression (SR) is a data-driven method for scientific discovery which searches for interpretable analytical relationships within data. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have also had a significant impact on scientific discovery, enabling the automation of various stages of the process. For these reasons, the possibility of harnessing the embedded scientific knowledge and programming capabilities of LLMs to solve SR tasks has emerged, showing promising performance compared with traditional methods. We propose EvoMO-SR, a novel LLM-driven SR framework in which the LLM generates equation skeletons, with their coefficients fitted separately by an external optimizer. The framework includes a multi-objective survival selection which controls bloating by balancing accuracy and complexity, and a substructure guidance mechanism which mutates expressions with candidate reusable building blocks. translated_title: EvoMO-SR：基于多目标大语言模型演化与子结构引导的符号表达式搜索
translated_abstract: 符号回归（SR）是一种数据驱动的科学发现方法，用于在数据中搜索可解释的解析关系。近年来，大语言模型（LLM）也对科学发现产生了重大影响，使这一过程的各个阶段得以自动化。因此，利用大语言模型中蕴含的科学知识和编程能力来解决符号回归任务的可能性应运而生，与传统方法相比展现出了有前景的性能。我们提出了 EvoMO-SR，这是一种新颖的由大语言模型驱动的符号回归框架，其中大语言模型生成方程骨架，其系数则由外部优化器单独拟合。该框架包含一个多目标生存选择机制，通过平衡精度与复杂度来控制表达式膨胀问题；还包含一个子结构引导机制，利用候选的可复用构建模块对表达式进行变异。EvoMO-SR 实现了最佳的精度
tldr: 提出了EvoMO-SR框架，利用大语言模型生成方程骨架并结合外部优化器拟合系数，通过多目标生存选择控制表达式膨胀，并借助子结构引导机制以可复用构建模块变异表达式，在符号回归任务上实现了最优精度。
en_tdlr: EvoMO-SR is a novel LLM-driven multiobjective symbolic regression framework that generates equation skeletons with externally fitted coefficients, controls bloating through multiobjective survival selection balancing accuracy and complexity, and mutates expressions via substructure guidance with reusable building blocks, achieving the best accuracy.
